name: SS Noordam
builder: Harland & Wolff, Belfast · Yard No. 338 · Slip No. 5
summary: Designed for the Rotterdam–New York route, she was a near-sister of Rijndam and belonged to the same broad group as the larger Potsdam. Her commercial purpose combined cabin travel, mail and cargo with accommodation for approximately 1,800 third-class passengers at the height of European migration to North America.
